# ===== PRESET: DEEP SCARY VOICE =====
# Gate -> Pitch down 7 semitones -> Dark EQ -> Heavy grit -> Compressor -> De-esser

# Noise gate
VSTPlugin: Library "ATKExpander x64.dll" Attack 0.097959 Release 1 Threshold 0.531507 Softness 1 Slope 0.142134
# Level (offsets the heavy saturation's +8.5 dB)
Preamp: 0 dB

# Pitch shift: -7 semitones, 100% shifted (pitchproof)
# Pitch -7 st, formant -3 st (GForm: cleaner than pitchproof on speech)
VSTPlugin: Library "GForm.dll" Form 0.372917 Pitch 0.20625 Oversmp 0 MinFreq 0.163054 MaxFreq 0.7818 Gate 0.1429
# Deep, dark monster EQ
Filter: ON HPQ Fc 55 Hz Q 0.707
# Chest-shaking rumble
Filter: ON PK Fc 90 Hz Gain 5 dB Q 0.9
# Body / weight
Filter: ON PK Fc 160 Hz Gain 3 dB Q 1.0
# Keep it from getting muddy
Filter: ON PK Fc 400 Hz Gain -3 dB Q 1.0
Filter: ON PK Fc 1000 Hz Gain -2 dB Q 1.0
# Darker, more menacing (less bright clarity)
Filter: ON PK Fc 3000 Hz Gain -4 dB Q 0.8
# Remove the top end: dark, shadowy
Filter: ON HSC Fc 5000 Hz Gain -8 dB

# Heavy grit / growl (Density 1.0, 80% mix)
VSTPlugin: Library "Density364.dll" ChunkData "zczMPgAAAAAAAIA/zcxMPw=="

# Compressor: big, in-your-face and steady
VSTPlugin: Library "TDR Kotelnikov.dll" ChunkData ""

# De-esser
VSTPlugin: Library "T-De-Esser 2.dll" ChunkData ""
